---
name: Security finding
about: Report a security issue, secret exposure, or hardening need.
title: "security: "
labels: security, needs-review
---

## Finding

Describe the security concern. Do not include real secrets or full private URLs.

## Evidence

Provide redacted evidence and affected paths.

## Impact

Describe what could go wrong if this is not fixed.

## Remediation

Describe the safest proposed fix.

## Verification

- [ ] Secret scan passes.
- [ ] Tests pass.
- [ ] Documentation updated.
- [ ] Credential rotation considered if exposure occurred.
